rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: Any landlord planning to end a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources together with the Notice to Quit or notice of non-renewal. Landlords must also submit the notice and tenant contact information to the City through an online portal.
rules.key_value: Warning for 1st offense; $300 per day for 2nd and subsequent offenses
rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses: $300 per day (page also says failure to submit information may result in a fine up to $300 per day). Violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.status_basis: Page describes the act as an ordinance in force and enforced by Inspectional Services; no dates stated.

coverage.summary: Applies to all landlords planning to end a tenancy agreement.

rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.
